subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] mm/swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a new page into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator, allowing callers to control when the page is added to the LRU. This change is necessary because the next patch needs to evaluate the refault of a swapped-in page before it becomes visible to reclaim, and adding the page to the LRU too early would interfere with this process. The swap cache allocator now returns a locked folio that is not on the LRU, allowing callers to add it to the LRU when they are ready.
